updateStream.policy: Track the generated starter for Git updates; use the canonical source for release rationale/provenance. Verify the source/starter correspondence on every update. Never run the upstream starter cleaner against this repository.

historicalImport.note: One-time synthetic 'ours' merge records the imported near-copy as ancestry (85/87 blobs matched). The bridge is not a claim that the original import was a Git merge; it must only ever target the historical starter, never a newer tip.
